question: What is the derivative of f(x) = x³ + 3x² - 5x + 7?
explanation: Using the power rule: d/dx(xⁿ) = nxⁿ⁻¹. So d/dx(x³ + 3x² - 5x + 7) = 3x² + 6x - 5 + 0 = 3x² + 6x - 5
